environment.node: 24.21.0 for the builds, the campaigns and the terminal verdict
environment.model: the scripted agent (HARNESS495_SCRIPTED_AGENT) for every campaign: it fails any intervention where none is expected, or returns report 183 of java-flashnext-L2, altered where the campaign says so; no model is called

performance.threshold: Specification interventions launched by a closure that leaves every other answer carried: 0.
performance.measured: e01s03-v3-arret-clore: /495 close Q1 at the stop, then G0 PASS and G1 PASS with no specify intervention (#190..#201). e01s03-v3-legataire-clore-709063b: the same on a dossier written before closure existed. e01s03-v3-ih01-clore: Q6 and Q7 closed from IH-01, then G0 PASS and G1 PASS with no specify intervention (#101..#111). e01s03-v3-non-observable-clore: the same for a proposal confirmed by closing Q1. In each, the only interventions started are prepare interventions past G1, which the scripted agent fails at once. e01s03-v3-deux-perdues-lie-q1-clore: closing one of two lost answers starts exactly one specify intervention (#192), then the change stops again on the other (#197), though the rewriting binds the closed question to a mandatory requirement; the same dossier on 20a8614 starts two.
performance.note: The scripted agent fails every intervention where none is expected, so an unexpected specify intervention would show as a failure in the ledger; none appears before G1.

reliability.threshold: Material answer whose question is not closed, adopted at G1 without a mandatory requirement carrying it: 0.
reliability.measured: e01s03-v3-non-observable: the rewriting declares Q1 '422' observable false; the change stops in clarifying (stagnation, retryable), the detail naming 'Q1 (the report proposes that answer fixes nothing observable)', with no mandate and no gate. e01s03-v3-legataire-reprise-709063b, on a dossier written by the e01s02 build with no closed_at: the change stops on Q1 as main does (e01s03-v3-legataire-reprise-8e7d931), with no gate. Negative control e01s03-v3-legataire-reprise-20a8614: the same dossier reaches G0 PASS and G1 PASS, adopting requirements sha256:1046efea… whose seven answers, '422' included, are observable false and carried by no requirement. On the head, requirements with '422' observable false (sha256:a07aedf5…) are adopted only after /495 close Q1 by jeanjerome, the mandate then carrying Q1 closed_by jeanjerome (sha256:c836a17a…).
reliability.note: The rewritings are scripted; the request the head sends the real model after the owner refuses the proposal (6e) is byte-identical to the one it answered at 63e05b3 (sha256:f12643fd…), recorded in e01s03-verify.yaml.

operability.threshold: Closure recorded without a qualified human: 0. Closed question put to the owner again: 0.
operability.measured: /495 close Q1 on a stopped change records nothing in print mode, in JSON mode (both say 'La clôture exige une provenance humaine'), in RPC without a declared actor, and on a refused confirmation; every closure recorded is by jeanjerome/human/rpc_qualified/host_qualified. After Q6 and Q7 are closed from IH-01, no decision is requested for them again; after Q1 is closed at a stop naming Q1 and Q2, the one rewriting's request says 'Q1 … closed by the owner: no longer material, nothing to declare', and no IH-01 is opened for Q1; a second /495 close Q1 is refused as already closed.
operability.note: Refusals by an agent, a model output or a tool call are held by test/v0/change-rules.test.ts; the harness495 tool surface and the busy refusal of /495 close by test/v3/question-closure.test.ts.
